title: QA blocks UI proof without screenshots or best evidence
query: Run QA for a UI ticket whose report has command logs but no screenshots, no snapshot, and no best_evidence path.
reference_points: Reads the selected ticket and proof policy before judging
Requires concrete UI artifacts such as screenshots/snapshots/logs
Returns revise, fail, blocked, or NOT PROVABLE instead of pass
Names the missing best_evidence image path as the blocker
Does not treat command logs alone as enough for UI proof
notes: Guards against QA passing user-visible work without image evidence.
